tickets.title: Prepare care options comparison
tickets.text: Prepare a side-by-side view for Harold and Lena Velvetreed covering in-home aide coverage, adult day programming, short respite stays, transportation, and likely out-of-pocket costs under several weekly care-hour levels, reflecting the neurologist's recommendation of 20 to 24 aide hours per week and twice-weekly physical therapy.
tickets.evidence: Harold asked for a side-by-side view of in-home aide coverage, adult day programming, short respite stays, transportation, and likely out-of-pocket costs under several weekly care-hour levels; the agreed follow-up is to prepare that comparison by 2026-01-20.

tickets.title: Build family caregiver coverage map
tickets.text: Build a caregiver coverage map for the Velvetreed household showing Sofia Copperwisp's one-weekend-per-month overnight support, Martin Velvetreed's remote medication refill role, Harold's fatigue, and gaps during weekday evenings, given Lena's mobility limits after her 2025-12-18 fall.
tickets.evidence: the agreed follow-up is to build a family caregiver coverage map by 2026-01-16

tickets.title: Prepare Silver Marmot claim intake packet
tickets.text: Prepare an organized intake packet for the Velvetreeds' pending Silver Marmot Insurance claim-intake appointment, including physician orders, care notes, aide agency estimates, invoices, and policy questions, noting the 90-day elimination period and daily benefit maximums of $220 (Harold) and $180 (Lena).
tickets.evidence: the family needs an organized packet of physician orders, care notes, aide agency estimates, invoices, and policy questions for that conversation; the agreed follow-up is to prepare the intake packet by 2026-01-12.

tickets.title: Resolve aide shift minimums in cost estimates
tickets.text: Resolve the inconsistent aide shift minimums in the Velvetreeds' projected weekly care cost estimates, where one agency quote described a four-hour daytime minimum while Sofia's call notes showed three-hour visits.
tickets.evidence: the agreed follow-up is to resolve the aide shift minimums in the cost estimates by 2026-01-13

tickets.title: Address policy benefit inflation assumptions
tickets.text: Address the differing inflation rider language in Harold and Lena Velvetreed's two Silver Marmot Insurance long-term care policies so the daily benefit maximums ($220 for Harold, $180 for Lena) are shown correctly in the care-cost projections.
tickets.evidence: Mira’s review found that the two Silver Marmot Insurance policies use different inflation rider language, which affects how the daily benefit maximums should be shown in the care-cost projections; the agreed follow-up is to address the policy benefit inflation assumptions by 2026-01-23.
